name: hocus-focus
description: Exam-focused study skill that distills screenshots, PDFs, PPTs, and lecture slides into brief, concise, strictly source-grounded explanations.

plugins.name: hocus-focus
plugins.description: Distill slides, screenshots, and PDFs into brief, exam-ready explanations with user-selectable modes (exam, quick, deep, compare, feynman, flashcards, quiz) and Karpathy's 4-level clarity ladder (ASD-STE100, diagrams, interactive HTML, Manim video).
